quest.title: Hyakunin Ikki: The Greatest Battle
quest.description: It seems that someone in Inazuma City is looking for an exceptional fighter...

dialogues.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
dialogues.text: Why hello there, outlander! Do you have any interest in a little scrap, by any chance?

choices.text: I've been in thousands of those.

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: Ah, wonderful! Glad I had my eye on the right person.

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: It's like this: recently, some people have organized a Hyakunin Ikki in secret again.

choices.text: Don't you mean the Hyakunin Isshu?

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: No, no, I said "Hyakunin Ikki." What on earth's the "Hyakunin Isshu," anyway...

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: This practice used to circulate amongst the Tengu-Kin, who imitated the tengu. Basically, they would do this—

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: When the situation went ill, when they felt down, when something worth celebrating occurred, or if they were simply bored...

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: They would engage in a hearty fight to celebrate, or simply to eliminate bad luck.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sounds like you could just hold it at any time...

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: ...Now that you mention it, that is true, yes.

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: Whatever the case, let's find another place to discuss this matter. There are too many people in the city for such talk...

choices.text: Do you have a commission for me?

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: Now, I wouldn't call this a commission...

dialogues.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
dialogues.text: You can enter the Hyakunin Ikki Dojo by stepping through this... rather suspicious door.

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: Though the Tengu-Kin have long been banned for flouting public order and morals, some still hold the Hyakunin Ikki free-for-all tournament from time to time.

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: Monsters, adventurers, and warriors who long for battle will be attracted here to engage in passionate battle on this stage.

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: Feel free to bring your friends and companions! After all, the "Hyakunin" in "Hyakunin Ikki" means the more, the merrier!

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: You seem like a well-traveled adventurer. You shouldn't lack for any companions to take part together with you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're not taking part?

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: Oh, of course I will — as a spectator, cheering you on!

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: In truth, my goal here is to write the most epic fighting novel ever and use it to take first prize in Yae Publishing House's "This Novel Is Amazing!" contest...

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: ...And my gut tells me that your star will shine brightest in this arena.

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: Great! In fact, I already have a name for my novel. I'm calling it "Hyakunin Ikki: Greatest Battle Chapter." If you should see it in Yae Publishing House's store one day, look out for the bit where the blond-haired outlander makes their debut!

response.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
response.text: I'm looking forward to your performance.
